blockers.resolution_test: Independent formal and claim-evidence review finds no contradiction at the declared scope.
Final hashes, archive memberships, rights, references, and research-integrity ledger verify.

levers.action: Bind every formal, empirical, negative, and availability claim to the exact final PDF and retained receipts.
levers.closure_test: Checksum-bound independent atomic-claim coverage and research-integrity verification pass.

levers.action: Present only the evidence-license/nonpromotion residual and explicitly credit donor fields.
levers.closure_test: No generic fixed-point, provenance, causality, belief-revision, security, or deployment novelty claim remains.

levers.action: Frame the paper as finite formal semantics plus executable automated-reasoning evaluation.
levers.closure_test: Venue contract and manuscript scope language agree.

levers.action: Provide exact editable source, PDF, artifact, declarations, rights, manifests, checksums, and sole-authority disposition.
levers.closure_test: Release verifier passes twice in a clean environment and all PDF pages pass visual QA.

levers.action: Apply the released academic-writing, section-craftsmanship, standalone-reader, narrative, and manuscript-surface gates.
levers.closure_test: All automated scanners pass or have exact contextual dispositions, and hostile review has no unresolved repair.
